newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: CITES endangered species meeting begins in Zimbabwe.
newsitem.headline: CITES endangered species meeting begins in Zimbabwe.

text.p: The Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species (CITES) began in Zimbabwe on Monday, with a hotly contested proposal by three southern African states to resume trade in ivory products expected to dominate the meeting.
The 10-day conference has attracted almost 3,000 delegates and observers, including some of the world's leading environmental organisations.

Besides the proposal by host Zimbabwe and its neighbours Botswana and Namibia for a partial relaxation of a 1989 CITES ban on ivory trade, the meeting has 115 other items on its agenda, including a proposal by Japan and Norway to open up whale hunting.
